answer: Seven forms took effect on February 1, 2026. Five are brand-new forms: NW-DMG-1 (Damage disclosure), NW-EST-1 (Heir and estate affidavit), NW-LPA-1 (Lender payoff authorization, for loans only, since leases use NW-LSE-1), NW-MIL-1 (Deployed owner authorization) and NW-PLT-1 (Plate return receipt, California). The other two are new versions of older forms. NW-ODO-2 (Odometer disclosure statement) replaced NW-ODO-1. NW-POA-2 (Power of attorney, e-sign) replaced the notarized NW-POA-1, though an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was accepted until June 30, 2026, and Georgia still requires NW-POA-2 to be notarized.
